label: Make ten (bridge through ten)
description: To solve a + b where a + b > 10: split b into a part that completes a to 10, and a remainder, then add the remainder onto 10. E.g. 8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3 = 10 + 3 = 13. Needs the concept of a 10-bond as a prerequisite, not just the sub-skills -- otherwise a child could pass split_10 and add_to in isolation without seeing why the decomposition is valid here.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
